name: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Database Engineer

third_party_evaluations.summary: Designs, migrates, and manages enterprise databases on Google Cloud.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 3. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Enterprise database design, migration and operations with three years of experience support professional data-platform decisions; recorded vendor specificity limits broader privacy or cross-cloud leadership claims.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Enterprise database design, migration and management with a three-year profile support professional cloud data responsibility. Proctoring is useful, but the record does not demonstrate practical security testing or portable database expertise.

alex-novak.rationale: Enterprise database design, migration and management in the recorded scope fit professional domain responsibility at three years. The evidence supports that database track rather than expert privacy or general security authority.
